answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained, honest service rather than accumulated once. In the EigenTrust matrix, fresh identities have negligible trusted incoming mass and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot quickly elevate them, so they cannot pass consensus thresholds. Like a dune beside a lagoon below a summit, apparent multiplicity adds no weight without durable, corroborated endorsements.
